sources.title: Kimi K2.7 Code: Open-Source Agentic Coding Model
sources.snippet: Kimi K2.7 Code is a coding-focused agentic model with improved long-horizon coding, stronger agent capabilities, and 30% lower thinking-token usage than K2.6.

sources.title: Kimi K2.7 Code - AI Model Library | Build on Vast.ai
sources.snippet: Kimi K2.7 Code is an open-source, native-multimodal agentic MoE model from Moonshot AI with 1T total parameters and 32B activated, natively INT4-quantized and specialized for long-horizon, coding-driven agentic workflows with thinking-mode reasoning, tool calling, and image input.
